definitions.explanation: A list of common questions and answers about a product, service, or topic.

examples.japanese: FAQに{答|こた}えが{載|の}っていた。
examples.english: The answer was in the FAQ.

examples.japanese: {質問|しつもん}する{前|まえ}にFAQページをご{覧|らん}ください。
examples.english: Please check the FAQ page before asking questions.

notes:
FAQ stands for Frequently Asked Questions. Pronounced エフエーキュー in Japanese. Found on websites, product manuals, and customer service pages.

JAPANESE EQUIVALENT:
The native equivalent is よくある{質問|しつもん}, which is more accessible to general audiences. FAQ tends to appear on tech-oriented or international-facing sites, while よくある{質問|しつもん} is preferred on Japanese consumer sites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- FAQページ: FAQ page
- FAQを{確認|かくにん}する: to check the FAQ
- FAQを{読|よ}む: to read the FAQ
- FAQに{追加|ついか}する: to add to the FAQ

RELATED WORDS:
- よくある{質問|しつもん}: frequently asked questions (native equivalent)
- Q&A（キューアンドエー）: questions and answers
- {問|と}い{合|あ}わせ: inquiries, contact
